scripts.dev: npm run build:worklet -w @soundfx/engine && concurrently -n worklet,web -c gray,cyan "npm run watch:worklet -w @soundfx/engine" "npm run dev -w @soundfx/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:worklet -w @soundfx/engine && npm run build -w @soundfx/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && node --test packages/*/test/*.test.js apps/*/test/*.test.js
